name: The K2
description: A patriotic bodyguard who was abandoned by his country and colleagues, a hidden daughter of leading Presidential candidate who regards love as a tool for revenge, and the First Lady contender who hides her ambition and charisma behind a kind and friendly personality.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When Assemblyman Jang Se-joon comes under attack, a mysterious banner hanger suddenly comes to his rescue showing incredible signs of combat training.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: President Park searches for Je Ha, who is on the run. Yoo Jin orders Anna be brought to Korea.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Se Joon uses an assassination attempt against Yoo Jin to further his campaign. Chief Joo offers Je Ha a job with JSS.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Yoo Jin convinces Je Ha that they can both benefit from working together, even when he doesn't quite fit in at JSS.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: At a funeral, Yoo Jin falls into a trap that she cannot escape without Je Ha's help.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Yoo Jin offers Je Ha a chance to find out more about his past. Anna escapes the house with the intent of finding her father.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After rushing to save Anna, Je Ha makes a difficult promise. Yoo Jin gives away information that could be used against her to secure an alliance.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The investigation that Se Joon asked for on Yoo Jin's family's company begins. As the search for Anna attracts more online attention, JSS scrambles to do damage control.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Anna meets a family member she didn't know she had who can change her life. Je Ha receives another employment offer.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Anna appeals to the public to find out more about her mother's death. The investigation of Se Joon takes a new turn.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The assassination does not turn out as planned, but Yoo Jin manages to turn it to her and Se Joon's advantage. Je Ha makes a deal with Park.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Anna asks Chairman Choi to help her get justice for her mother. An online post that goes viral results in a re-investigation of Hye Rin's death that may get Yoo Jin arrested.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Se Joon's explanation of Yoo Jin's statement to the press may not be enough to save his candidacy. Yoo Jin tries to convince Anna to leave the country.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Je Ha is seriously wounded trying to get Kim Suk Han's memory card. Park decides to take advantage of the confusion and bring down JSS.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Yoo Jin refuses to give up Cloud Nine without a fight. Je Ha agrees to give Park Kwan Soo the memory card.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Chairman Choi takes Anna hostage, but ends up trapped in Cloud Nine with Se Joon, Yoo Jin, and the bomb.
